sections.heading: A multi-sector EU agenda
paragraphs: The Council of the European Union source summary records that, after the European Council meeting of 15–16 October 2026, President António Costa presented discussions on competitiveness and energy prices, trade, the next multiannual financial framework, Ukraine and migration.

These topics connect internal economic management with foreign-policy and cross-border concerns. The practical consequence for analysis is that European decisions in one domain may influence others, such as how energy costs affect competitiveness or how external crises affect migration policy.
The limitation is evidentiary: the summary does not specify individual decisions, legal instruments, funding amounts or implementation timelines.

sections.heading: How to frame the India angle
paragraphs: For India, the agenda is relevant because EU economic and trade choices can affect market access, standards, investment and supply chains, while energy discussions can influence cooperation and competitiveness. Ukraine and migration also matter for India’s engagement with Europe on diplomacy, mobility and global stability.

These are analytical implications rather than verified outcomes of the meeting. A precise UPSC answer should therefore use the record as a starting point for issue mapping, not as proof that a new EU policy was adopted.
